projects.name: agent-skills
projects.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
projects.ai_summary: 提供适用于AI编码代理的生产级工程技能。采用JavaScript实现，聚焦于提升AI代理的代码质量和工程实践能力。

projects.name: OfficeCLI
projects.description: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.
projects.ai_summary: 专为AI代理设计的Office套件，支持读写和自动化处理Word、Excel、PPT文件。基于C#开发，单二进制文件且无需安装Office，实现轻量化部署。

projects.name: awesome-design-md
projects.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
projects.ai_summary: 收集知名品牌设计系统的DESIGN.md文件，用于生成匹配的UI界面。通过标准化设计文档，使编码代理能快速构建风格统一的界面。

projects.name: system_prompts_leaks
projects.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Claude Code, Claude Design. OpenAI - ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking, GPT 5.5 Instant, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
projects.ai_summary: system_prompts_leaks - Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Claude Code,... 使用 JavaScript 开发。

projects.name: claude-video
projects.description: Give Claude the ability to watch any video. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes, hands it all to Claude.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目赋予Claude AI处理视频的能力，通过下载视频、提取帧和转录内容来解析视频信息。采用Python实现，结合计算机视觉与自然语言处理技术，实现视频内容的结构化分析。

projects.name: pentagi
projects.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
projects.ai_summary: Pentagi 是一个全自动 AI 代理系统，用于执行复杂的渗透测试任务。采用 Go 语言实现，通过自主决策和任务编排实现高效的漏洞探测与攻击模拟。

projects.name: crawl4ai
projects.description: 🚀🤖 Crawl4AI: Open-source LLM Friendly Web Crawler & Scraper. Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN
projects.ai_summary: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的、对大型语言模型友好的网络爬虫和抓取工具，旨在简化网页数据的收集和处理。该项目采用 Python 实现，支持高效抓取和结构化数据输出，便于后续 AI 模型训练和分析。

projects.name: claude-cookbooks
projects.description: A collection of notebooks/recipes showcasing some fun and effective ways of using Claude.
projects.ai_summary: claude-cookbooks 是一个展示如何使用 Claude 模型的有趣且高效方法的 Jupyter Notebook 集合。这些 Notebook 提供了多种实用场景的代码示例和最佳实践，帮助开发者快速上手 Claude 的应用开发。

projects.name: DesktopCommanderMCP
projects.description: This is MCP server for Claude that gives it terminal control, file system search and diff file editing capabilities
projects.ai_summary: DesktopCommanderMCP 是一个为 Claude 设计的 MCP 服务器，赋予其终端控制、文件系统搜索和文件差异编辑能力。该项目基于 TypeScript 实现，通过模块化架构提供灵活的终端交互和文件管理功能。

projects.name: meetily
projects.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows.
projects.ai_summary: meetily - Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcr... 使用 Rust 开发。
